pointers.label: Agent
pointers.orientation: a structural label for a participant treated as initiating, carrying, or being attributed an action

pointers.label: Alignment
pointers.orientation: a structural label for the degree or rule by which purposes, incentives, representations, or axes correspond

pointers.label: Attribution
pointers.orientation: a structural label for assigning a source, cause, stance, responsibility, or authorship under stated evidence and rules

pointers.label: Audience
pointers.orientation: a structural label for the intended, addressed, reached, or interpreting participants of a communication or presentation

pointers.label: Cardinality
pointers.orientation: a structural label for the number of members, links, values, or allowed participants under a declared counting rule

pointers.label: Community
pointers.orientation: a structural label for a bounded group sharing practices, resources, language, governance, or evaluative expectations

pointers.label: Completeness
pointers.orientation: a structural label for whether a declared set, account, partition, or record satisfies its stated coverage contract

pointers.label: Dependence
pointers.orientation: a structural label for variation, availability, meaning, or outcome that is conditioned on another declared factor

pointers.label: Detection
pointers.orientation: a structural label for the method, threshold, observer, and time by which a condition or event becomes identified

pointers.label: Expression
pointers.orientation: a structural label for an observable form that realizes, communicates, or records content under a medium and convention

pointers.label: History
pointers.orientation: a structural label for prior states, events, selections, transformations, or custody that constrain present interpretation

pointers.label: Language
pointers.orientation: a structural label for the named linguistic system, variety, vocabulary, or convention governing an expression

pointers.label: Medium
pointers.orientation: a structural label for the material, channel, format, or mode through which content is realized or conveyed

pointers.label: Participation
pointers.orientation: a structural label for entry, contribution, involvement, response, or withdrawal under declared conditions

pointers.label: Performance
pointers.orientation: a structural label for realized behavior or execution assessed under a declared task, criterion, context, and evidence

pointers.label: Persistence
pointers.orientation: a structural label for continued identity, condition, effect, or availability across a declared interval and change rule

pointers.label: Propagation
pointers.orientation: a structural label for how a change, signal, effect, constraint, or failure travels across connected participants

pointers.label: Reporting
pointers.orientation: a structural label for the authority, content, timing, audience, and limitations of a communicated record

pointers.label: Scheme
pointers.orientation: a structural label for a named system of categories, identifiers, rules, scales, or evaluation conventions

pointers.label: Variation
pointers.orientation: a structural label for differences across subjects, forms, contexts, time, or observations under a declared comparison basis
